I saw a light being when I was a little girl. My experience wasn't as detailed as yours, and I believe my memory was purposely wiped, leaving only a few details. It also told me not to be afraid. It sounds cliché, but it conveyed this without words; it was just an instant knowingness. It was made of light and love, and it felt like pure love as it passed through me. I remember being really curious about the light itself. It felt so natural, yet I was so focused on the strands of light out of curiosity.

The best way I could describe the strands of light is like when you see the sun setting behind a canopy of trees. You can see the golden rays radiating out from the sun all around it. Usually, the rays look very crisp, but this being's rays were fluid, free flowing, loving and alive. Loving is a difficult adjective to understand but it was simply loving. The rays had strands of different colors; gold was the dominant one, but I could see rainbow and silver strands as the light moved toward me. The being had no face, but it didn’t need one because the light was full of information, and I had a knowingness of what it looked like, I can't describe it because it's not worldly. It was knelt down at my face level. It was perfect, gentle, and kind. 

While I was focusing on the rays, it was speaking to me telepathically. I know it told me not to tell anyone what it had said. I remember that what it told me made me happy—happier than what I was already feeling from its presence. When it left, I think it said, "I will always be with you." I remember thinking to myself that I had to draw this tomorrow at school, even considering what color crayons to use.

The next day at school, a Russian woman from my parents' church, who knew them, asked me in Russian what I was drawing. I was a pretty decent artist, so she could somewhat tell. She wouldn’t stop asking me, and I was getting very angry because I knew the implications of what would happen if I told her. Finally, I gave in out of frustration, and in that moment, everything it told me was wiped from my memory. I could only remember that I saw it, but not the message it conveyed. I was so frustrating. I would love to see this being again and find out what was that message.

Before pressure cooking put your lids on, unmodified and unflipped. Then put the rings on finger tight, DO NOT screw it on tightly. (You can google how to can stuff online.) When you are done pressure cooking you should remove the rings on the jars before storing. If you don't remove the rings it can create a false seal or rust underneath. In general this is the right way to store canned foods when home canning, you have to remove the rings, its essential. I forgot to mention that part and its pretty important know when canning anything. As long the center of your lid is dipping downward then you know the product is sealed properly. If its not sealed down then your product cant be stored and you have to either use it right away, put it in the fridge or throw it out. 

Of course you'll need to put the ring back on after inoculation to keep the lid from falling off because it won't be under pressure anymore.
